title: NIT Calicut Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Project Associate Posts
description: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill vacancies for 01 Project Associate I position. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech in Civil Engineering courses can grab this chance and apply for the NIT Calicut Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates...
